name: circular_fin_transient
title: Transient temperature distribution in a 1-D circular fin
summary: Transient temperature field of a straight circular fin (3 cm long, 3 mm diameter) discretised into 11 finite-volume nodes and integrated in time: a constant heat flow of 0.5 W enters the base, the fin loses heat to the ambient air by convection, and the temperature of the 11 nodes is tabulated along the trajectory.

origin.notes: EES example of F-Chart Software, distributed by the EES-Community/ees-examples repository (commit 5c703d0, folder Integral/). Plain-text export of the EES equations window: it stores no solution and has no .eez companion, so no EES reference could be extracted. Credit: (c) F-Chart Software / S. A. Klein, MIT via EES-Community/ees-examples. The file itself names no author; the attribution follows the credit of the collection and the authors column of the inventory row EEX-448.

verification.summary: No EES reference exists (plain-text source, no stored solution). The runnable variant was checked with the energy balance of the fin: 25 J supplied = 10.506 J stored + 14.494 J convected to the air, closure 3.4e-13 J; the convected heat recomputed by trapezoidal integration of the tabulated trajectory agrees to 2.9e-7, and doubling the integration step changes no temperature.
verification.reference: energy balance of the fin computed by the model (post-processing block of the variant) and recomputed by trapezoidal integration of the trajectory circular_fin_transient_coolsolve-integral.csv; limiting case q*t/(rho*c*V) = 73.68 K computed by hand
verification.notes: Energy balance of the variant at t = 50 s: E_in = q_dot*t_sim = 25.000000 J, E_stored = 10.505827 J, E_conv = 14.494174 J, closure error -3.4e-13 J (1.3e-14 relative). Trapezoidal integration of the 1001-row trajectory gives E_conv = 14.494169 J (2.9e-07 relative, quadrature error). Time-step refinement (1000 -> 2000 steps): T[1] = 102.7823538774 degC in both runs, all temperatures identical to 10 significant digits. The native file is blocked by CS-GAP-INTEGRAL-DUPLICATE and CS-GAP-INDEX-VAR and was not verified.
